title: Size of the Converted Constraint Multiset
statement: For any multiset of three-variable linear constraints over $\mathbb{F}_2$, converting each constraint into its four three-variable E3-SAT clauses yields a multiset whose cardinality is exactly four times the cardinality of the original multiset.
hypotheses_covered: A multiset of constraints from the three-variable linear template
